'''Nashal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the director of a research team on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operatives posing as spacers.
